title: 列車定位與里程融合
summary: 本課聚焦多感測定位的誤差相關性與完整性。從輪徑比例與里程建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把定位不確定度合成與融合感測時基漂移連成可驗證的介面，最後以失訊與錯圖案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies error correlation and integrity in multisensor train localization. Start with wheel-scale error and odometry to define physical or information boundaries, connect combining localization uncertainty with clock drift in sensor fusion as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through signal-loss and map-error cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪徑比例與里程。原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。敏感度只改 distance=1500 至 1650 m，輸出變為 6.8 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究局部通過速度觀測：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel-scale error and odometry. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. For sensitivity, change only distance=1500 to 1650 m; the output becomes 6.8 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate local passage-speed observations: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 輪徑比例與里程與局部通過速度觀測
stages.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry & Local passage-speed observations
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪徑比例與里程」與「局部通過速度觀測」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wheel-scale error and odometry" and "Local passage-speed observations": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪徑比例與里程」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel-scale error and odometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。輪滑與空轉使輪周距離不等於地面位移；定期地標校正能約束累積誤差，但地標本身的位置與辨識可信度仍須驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪徑比例與里程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow. Slip makes wheel travel differ from ground displacement. Landmark updates can constrain drift, but the landmark position and identification credibility still require verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel-scale error and odometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪徑比例與里程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪徑比例與里程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel-scale error and odometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪徑比例與里程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel-scale error and odometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。以「輪徑比例與里程」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects. For wheel-scale error and odometry, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only travelled distance distance from 1500 to 1650 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6.2 to 6.8 m. Explain the causal direction for wheel-scale error and odometry, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪徑比例與里程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel-scale error and odometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。回到「輪徑比例與里程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Trace the input chain for wheel-scale error and odometry. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. stages.title: 獨立觀測加權融合與定位不確定度合成

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent observations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「獨立觀測加權融合」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weighted fusion of independent observations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較輪速與外部定位的權重，只有在獨立無偏假設有證據時才採用倒變異數加權。獨立無偏觀測可依變異數倒數加權，較小不確定度取得較大權重。融合不會自動修正共同偏差或地圖錯誤；如果兩個感測器實際共享同一來源，當成獨立資料就會過度自信，並把錯誤估計包裝成精準結果。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩個獨立高斯無偏位置觀測，不含跨時間濾波與完整性保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「獨立觀測加權融合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare weights for wheel-based and external position observations, using inverse-variance fusion only when independence and lack of bias are justified. Independent unbiased observations can be weighted by inverse variance, giving more weight to lower uncertainty. Fusion does not automatically remove common bias or map errors. Treating two sensors that share a source as independent creates false confidence and can make an incorrect estimate appear precise. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent Gaussian unbiased position observations, without temporal filtering or integrity assurance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weighted fusion of independent observations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weighted fusion of independent observations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：觀測一位置 x1=100 m；觀測二位置 x2=104 m；觀測一標準差 s1=2 m；觀測二標準差 s2=4 m。公式 y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)，代入得 y=100.8 m。邊界：兩個獨立高斯無偏位置觀測，不含跨時間濾波與完整性保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first observed position x1=100 m; second observed position x2=104 m; first standard deviation s1=2 m; second standard deviation s2=4 m. Formula y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2) gives y=100.8 m. Boundary: Two independent Gaussian unbiased position observations, without temporal filtering or integrity assurance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以保留的獨立真值資料檢查殘差平均與分布，另測共同偏移時是否仍能被辨識。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use held-out independent truth to examine residual mean and spread, then test whether a shared offset remains detectable.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「獨立觀測加權融合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weighted fusion of independent observations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以保留的獨立真值資料檢查殘差平均與分布，另測共同偏移時是否仍能被辨識。以「獨立觀測加權融合」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use held-out independent truth to examine residual mean and spread, then test whether a shared offset remains detectable. For weighted fusion of independent observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. steps.observation: 現場實務：只把觀測二標準差 s2 從 4 改成 4.4 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 100.8 變為 100.685 m。先說明「獨立觀測加權融合」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for weighted fusion of independent observations, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同地圖誤差可讓兩感測器互相同意卻都錯，將相關性忽略會縮小不合理的信賴區間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
